rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when simply conceding that something is true.

example.english: Admittedly, the food at this restaurant is quite tasty.
example.traditional: 的確，呢間餐廳啲嘢幾好食。
example.jyutping: dik1 kok3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this for a candid personal admission rather than a neutral statement that something is true.

example.english: Admittedly, I really don’t want to wait any longer.
example.traditional: 老實講，我真係唔想再等喇。
example.jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 zoi3 dang2 laa3

rows.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 A daan6 hai6 B
rows.note: Use this when the admission introduces a concession followed by a counterpoint.

example.english: Admittedly, it’s raining today, but we still have to go out.
example.traditional: 雖然今日落雨，但係我哋都要出門口。
example.jyutping: seoi1 jin4 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 ceot1 mun4 hau2
